summary: Searches an integer array whose element count is at offset 0x10 and whose data pointer is at offset 0x14 for a value equal to argument a2. If found, the element at that index is replaced with the last element and the count at offset 0x10 is decremented (swap-remove). Returns the index of the removed element, or the count value when the value is not present.

operations.description: When the element count at offset 0x10 is not greater than 0 the function returns 0 immediately (empty array)
Iterates the integer array at offset 0x14 from index 0, advancing while the current element differs from a2, and stops early when the running index reaches the count at offset 0x10
When the value a2 is not found before the index reaches the count, returns the count value (index one past the end)
When a2 is found, decrements the element count at offset 0x10 by 1
Replaces the found element in the array at offset 0x14 with the last element of the array (swap-remove)
Returns the index of the removed element, or the count when a2 was not found

unresolved: The identity of the object owning offsets 0x10 and 0x14 is unknown
